description: We are Interstellar Nexus, a team of six passionate young minds fascinated by space, science, and technology. Taking on NASA's "Abandoned but not Forgotten" challenge, we aim to uncover hidden stories through research, creativity, and innovation. United by curiosity, teamwork, and a determination to excel, we are here to learn, gain hands-on experience, push boundaries, and transform ambitious ideas into meaningful solutions. We don't just explore the unknown; we strive to make a difference.
